ov: فيلم وثائقي من إخراج David Bickerstaff (2026)
plotEn: Turner & Constable is a 2026 documentary film which explores the relationship between rival painters J. M. W. Turner and John Constable. It was released as part of the 2025-2026 exhibition Turner and Constable: Rivals and Originals at Tate Britain.
